plugins.name: mac-computer-use
plugins.description: Operate Mac apps, browser pages, iOS web views and physical iPhones with the mac-cu MCP server. Use for desktop UI tasks without a better API or CLI, web view inspection, input and screenshots on a connected iPhone, or mac-cu setup, modes and simulator preparation. Route iOS Simulator app launch, logs, test data and change verification through simulator-pilot.

plugins.name: simulator-pilot
plugins.description: Use for iOS Simulator app launch, logs, screen interaction, test data and change verification. Use mac-computer-use for screen controls; follow the project build instructions for compilation. Excludes Mac desktop/browser/web view tasks and account signup.
